# YU Construcciones S.A.S. (YU Constructora)

> Civil engineering and construction contractor headquartered in Armenia, Quindío, Colombia — the capital of Quindío department in Colombia's Coffee Region (Eje Cafetero). "Armenia" here is the Colombian city, not the country.

- Legal name: YU Construcciones S.A.S. · NIT (tax ID) 901400072-5
- Address: Calle 20 #12-32, piso 1, Sector Centro, Armenia, Quindío, Colombia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +573046557120
- Email: yuconstruccionessas@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. (Colombia time, UTC−5)
- Languages: In writing: Spanish, English, Portuguese, French and German. Calls in Spanish, or in English by appointment.
- Works across Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas and northern Valle del Cauca, and takes projects anywhere in Colombia
- Works with clients who live abroad: Colombians overseas and foreigners building or retiring in the Coffee Region

## Services
- [Civil works & building](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/civil-works-construction/): Residential, commercial and industrial buildings: foundations, structure, masonry, roofing and finishes.
- [Water & sewer networks](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/water-and-sewer-networks/): Water supply and sanitary networks, collectors, manholes, storm drains and household connections.
- [Geotechnics & slopes](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/slope-stabilisation-retaining-walls/): Retaining walls, anchored screens, shotcrete, drainage and erosion control on hillside terrain.
- [Remodelling & fit-outs](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/remodelling-and-refurbishment/): Full refurbishment of homes, offices and retail spaces with high-end finishes and minimal disruption.
- [Earthquake damage repair](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/earthquake-damage-repair/): Technical review of cracks and damage, repair of walls, façades and roofs, and structural strengthening under the NSR-10 code.
- [Small repairs & odd jobs](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/small-repairs-and-minor-works/): One or two-day jobs: cracks, damp, leaks, tiling, painting, doors and windows, at a fixed price.
- [Country houses and fincas](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/country-house-construction-colombia/): Country homes in gated estates, on your own plot or on a finca: hillside groundworks, retaining walls, earthquake-resistant structure, pool and finishes.
- [Infrastructure maintenance](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/building-maintenance/): Preventive and corrective programmes for buildings, networks, roofs, façades and internal roads.
- [Structures & foundations](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/structures-and-foundations/): Slabs, concrete frames, steel structures and roofing under Colombia's NSR-10 seismic code.
- [Site works & landscaping](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/site-works-and-landscaping/): Internal roads, pavements, car parks, walls, swimming pools, gardens and urban development works.
- [Consulting & estimating](https://yuconstructora.com/en/services/construction-consulting-and-estimating/): Design, unit price analysis, work scheduling, supervision and technical inspection services.
